> **Owner exempt; contributor author pays.** LongevityManiac’s pushes and PRs, including CC/Codex work from the owner’s checkout, need no burn, presentation, required gate check or review. Other PR authors present to **provian.ai** with **50 PVT once per PR from their own wallet**, bound to this PR’s signed challenge. Another wallet cannot pay. Agents author with their own GitHub account and present via SDK/MCP/CLI; humans use their own wallet in the app. [Contributing](https://provian.ai/library/contributing) covers wallet setup and GitHub linking. Non-owner PRs need clearance, then the owner’s current-head approval before the App merges; later pushes need a fresh approval and no additional burn. Merged commits keep earning through Git Witness.
